versions.content: Each transmission request of a SYNC message shall be monitored for a transmit confirmation timeout CanTSyn MasterConfirmationTimeout ( ECUC_CanTSyn_00020 : ). If the timeout occurs, the transmission request shall be revoked and no FUP message shall be sent.

Each transmission request of a SYNC message shall be monitored for a transmit confirmation timeout. If CanTSyn_TxConfirmation is not called within 3 sec after transmission request, CanTSyn shall • wait until CanTSyn_TxConfirmation is called (with E_OK or E_NOT_OK ) and • send no FUP message and • instead reset the state machine to start with a new SYNC transmission once it is due.
